name: bottasker-actions
description: Build and operate BotTasker apps through the BotTasker MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Create and operate BotTasker apps with MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: BotTasker Actions gives Codex guided skills for creating apps, Data Hubs, catalogs, products, carts, useful dashboards for tracking and control, boards with secure sharing and automation buttons, AI agents, subagents, dynamic tools, workflows, and operational modules through the BotTasker external MCP.
defaultPrompt: Create a BotTasker app with data models and workflows.
Design a Data Hub and dashboard in BotTasker.
Design dashboards for tracking, control, KPIs, and area-specific follow-up in BotTasker.
Design a BotTasker board with source data, detail widgets, button automations, and secure public or restricted sharing.
Design a catalog with products, variants, modifiers, availability, and sales carts.
Build an AI agent with subagents and dynamically discovered tools in BotTasker.
